protocol: B1-B5 frozen calibration planning, not observed treatment evidence

normal_binary_reference.provenance: Previously published v1 planning reference, retained rather than retuned on v2 test.

stage2_power_claim: 2000/arm risk-only and 1000/arm exploration are assumed learning allocations, NOT powered evidence of positive contribution.
stage_cost_caveat: Illustrative contact/startup envelope only; shared measurement is assumed existing. Actual linkage, consent, engineering, clustering, follow-up and legal costs must be quoted before launch. No subsidy/discount.
capacity_caveat: Stage 1 needs 15744 core accounts, exceeding a single approximately10000-account top list in a100000-account scenario. Enroll across a larger eligible portfolio or successive cohorts; do not equate the pilot with one financial-scenario cohort.
randomization_unit: Linked household/account, linkage required before launch; Customer_ID is not claimed to be household-disjoint.
stratification: Cell and pre-treatment risk-value band; account clusters stay in one arm.
cell_disjointness: both+rv_only are stage1 core; rv_only is never enrolled twice. Stage2 adds risk_only and below-union exploration, each disjoint from stage1.
ipw_rule: Within eligible consented linked accounts use joint e_T=s*.5, e_C=s*.5; HT/IPW contrast T*Y/e_T-C*Y/e_C, including outcome-specific contact costs. Only the agreed region (both) cancels in the Bayes-minus-risk policy contrast: deployment-mass-weighted incremental contribution in rv_only minus that in risk_only; stage1 core includes rv_only and must not be cancelled as a whole. Exploration gives positive support below both cutoffs. Consent/nonresponse and household clustering require separate treatment; no unbiased claim for unconsented/unobserved accounts.

routing.window_caveat: No Range columns. Billing uses verified 3/6-month comparisons and separately an ambiguously scaled change_rev flag, never an inferred Mean window or causal promo expiry.
routing.residual_caveat: The fourth queue is a low-usage DIGITAL CHECK plus all remaining cases; not every residual is demonstrably low usage. Missing diagnostics do not prove a defect.

simulation.outcome: Simulated six-month contribution=3.6*V*(1-future_churn)-treatment_contact_cost; treatment prevents20% of otherwise churners. Assumes six-month contribution is lost when the specified future-month churn event occurs.
simulation.effective_n: floor(.9*enrolled), random missing follow-up proxy; full enrolled treatment cost and startup still charged.
simulation.adjustment: Fixed weighted OLS control-outcome coefficients fit on calibration rows only, covariate preprocessing on original60k; test never fits adjustment.
simulation.required_n_rule: Smallest preregistered grid point with simulated power>=.8; Monte Carlo Wilson95% interval reported. Beyond-grid requirements recorded unavailable. Final test required_n is descriptive, never a new enrollment decision.
simulation.honesty: No longitudinal pre/post contribution pairs or treatment/control labels. This cross-sectional independent-account proxy is NOT measured CUPED, causal lift or household-clustered profit power; re-estimate from live pre-period billing and clustering.

decision_gates.scale: Final cluster-robust95% LCB of incremental contribution after all contact/incentive/implementation costs >0 AND no guardrail breach; report policy value with logged enrollment/assignment propensities.
decision_gates.extend: Contribution CI overlaps0 with positive upper bound, no harm, and a prospectively approved maximum-sample/budget extension; no unplanned optional peeking.
decision_gates.stop: Contribution upper bound<=0, infeasible fully loaded costs, or customer-harm guardrail.
decision_gates.harm_stratum: mou_Mean<=original60k p25 AND ovrrev_Mean=0 AND custcare_Mean=0; missing diagnostic is not zero.
decision_gates.harm_stop: Positive treatment-minus-control churn and one-sided Fisher exact p<=.005 at either planned look; familywise alpha<=.01 for this stratum. Serious complaints/consent violations trigger immediate safety escalation independent of statistical significance.
decision_gates.source_scope: Ascarza2016 tested plan recommendations, not this exact stratum/action. The low-usage guardrail is a preregistered safety hypothesis, not an established backfire segment.
